mainEntity.name: How do I know whether AI-generated business content is accurate enough to sell?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Use AI to accelerate research, outlining, drafting, and organization, but verify important facts before using them in a product. Run My AI Biz’s educational approach includes source checking and safeguards against invented statistics, proof, or income claims.

AI-generated material may be incomplete, outdated, repetitive, or unsuitable for your audience. A polished draft can still contain incorrect claims or copied-sounding language.

Key factors:
- Whether claims can be checked against reliable sources.
- The originality of examples, images, and wording.
- The sensitivity of customer or business data entered.
- Your quality standard for a paid product.

Use AI for a first outline, then fact-check, rewrite in your own voice, add useful examples, and test the material with a real reader. Keep a record of sources for factual sections and remove unsupported promises.

Run My AI Biz can teach the review process, but the owner remains responsible for the final product.
acceptedAnswer.description: Treat AI output as a draft. Verify factual claims, check sources, remove unsupported statistics or promises, review originality, and add your own expertise before selling or publishing the material.
